description: Authoritative registry of tools ai-toolkit integrates with. Consumed by scripts/ecosystem_doctor.py to detect upstream doc/version drift.

tools.release_review_note: 2026-11-06 classes A/B/C: GitHub latest release and npm latest both identify 2.1.318 (2026-11-04). npm stable remains 2.1.311; next is 2.1.319, explaining the newer local binary without treating it as latest production. Existing hook, skill and plugin contracts remain compatible. Adopted documented onFailure:block for three existing PreToolUse safety guards; optional mods, gateway and admin settings are not auto-enabled.
tools.status_note: Claude Code auto-discovers native plugin skills, commands, agents, workflows, output styles, themes, hooks, MCP servers, LSP servers, monitors, executables, and root settings. ai-toolkit's primary install emits its existing rules, skills, agents, and hooks; plugin workflows, output styles, themes, monitors, LSP servers, channels, and root plugin settings are recognized class C surfaces that ai-toolkit does not generate. Themes and monitors are experimental, and plugin settings support only agent and subagentStatusLine.

documentation_review.note: Reviewed hooks, skills, plugin manifest and releases. PreToolUse guard-destructive/path/config now block on command startup/crash/timeout failure through onFailure:block (requires Claude Code >=2.1.295); advisory handlers are unchanged. Legacy untagged entries migrate by command identity without duplicate guards. Native output contracts remain compatible; new mod effort and organization settings remain opt-in. Older clients are not covered by the new failure-policy guarantee.

tools.status_note: Claude Chat/Desktop/Cowork does not scan ~/.claude/rules, CLAUDE.md, or Claude Code's user settings, so skills, agents, hooks, and rules ship only as an uploadable plugin ZIP plus Cowork global instructions. Local MCP servers are the exception: the app reads claude_desktop_config.json directly, so `ai-toolkit mcp install --editor claude-app --scope global` configures them without a plugin. That file accepts stdio entries only; HTTP/SSE templates are bridged through mcp-remote. Skills work in Chat and Cowork; plugin hooks and sub-agents run only in Cowork.

documentation_review.note: Plugin ZIP, account sync, skill/command availability and Cowork-only hook/subagent boundaries remain documented. Account plugins sync to Claude Code >=2.1.273. The generated bundle preserves guard onFailure policies, but the Help documentation does not expose a Cowork hook-runtime version, so hosted enforcement was not independently runtime-tested. No account settings changed.
access_notes: No public stable Cowork runtime semver or authenticated hosted-runtime smoke test; exported schema preservation is tested locally.

tools.release_review_note: 2026-11-06 classes A/C: reviewed dated November 5 product release notes and current plugin documentation. Product release notes do not expose one stable app/runtime semver. Enterprise inference hooks/admin controls and personal-finance UI do not require toolkit plugin changes.

tools.status_note: Cursor 3.11 adds cloud-agent conversation hooks. ai-toolkit emits the complete documented version-1 event set and a self-contained repository runtime under .cursor/hooks/ai-toolkit/; project hook commands do not depend on user-level ~/.cursor or ~/.softspark paths. User entries are preserved and legacy _source-tagged toolkit entries are migrated to schema-valid command ownership markers.

documentation_review.note: Rechecked all 21 emitted version-1 hook events and custom-agent frontmatter against current reference. Existing quoted portable runtimes and model:inherit remain valid. Cloud-agent limits and workspaceOpen plugin discovery are documented; new hosted app deployment and Agent SDK surfaces are not added to editor configuration. No model or permission defaults changed.

tools.release_review_note: 2026-11-06 classes A/C: the official product release-notes timeline lists Cursor IDE and Agents Window 3.27, dated 2026-10-22. The November 5 hosted-app announcement is a separate cloud capability, not a new declared IDE version. Hook and native agent contracts remain compatible.

tools.status_note: Windsurf rebranded to Devin Desktop on 2026-06-02. .devin/ is the primary rules/workflows/hooks tree; legacy .windsurf rules remain a read fallback. Cascade and its .windsurf/hooks.json format ended on 2026-07-01, so ai-toolkit now emits only .devin/hooks.v1.json. Current Devin skill docs list project .agents/skills, .devin/skills and .windsurf/skills, and user ~/.agents/skills, ~/.config/devin/skills and ~/.codeium/<channel>/skills; ai-toolkit emits a single canonical pointer under .windsurf/skills and no longer also writes .devin/skills. Devin CLI also imports ~/.claude/settings.json hooks when read_config_from.claude is enabled.

documentation_review.note: Standalone .devin/hooks.v1.json remains unwrapped. Context-only handlers now request JSON with hookSpecificOutput.hookEventName and additionalContext; guard commands retain their existing exit-2 or flat verdict behavior. The runtime integration test proves prompt/edit context is delivered and destructive commands still block. Skill discovery still accepts the emitted .windsurf/skills pointer. Both native and legacy rule directories are loaded by current Devin CLI; dual emission remains a compatibility choice, not fallback deduplication. Enterprise/model-picker changes remain unadopted.

tools.release_review_note: 2026-11-06 classes A/B/C: reviewed Devin Desktop stable 3.11.238, published 2026-10-30. Recent Desktop changes concern UI, diagnostics and account policies. Corrected generated prompt/edit hook output against the current Devin lifecycle contract. https://docs.devin.ai/desktop/changelog

documentation_review.note: Native v1 hook files and supported camelCase events remain valid, including flat Stop decisions and snake_case aliases. Context envelopes retain the event name. Generated agents omit model overrides and retired infer metadata. New session-management/UI/sandbox settings remain opt-in; agent-scoped hooks, direct exec/args and prompt/HTTP handlers are not emitted. Current documentation confirms hooks live in settings.json rather than config.json; toolkit emits independent hooks files and needs no migration.

tools.release_review_note: 2026-11-06 classes A/C: reviewed Copilot CLI stable 1.0.106, published 2026-11-06. This is the CLI release, not a version claim for every IDE extension or cloud agent. Current release changes diagnostics, configuration UX, sandbox extensions and runtime reliability; emitted native hooks, instructions, skills and agent metadata remain compatible. https://github.com/github/copilot-cli/releases/tag/v1.0.106

2026-11-06 classes A/B/C: reviewed stable Gemini CLI 0.67.0 (2026-11-04). The documented stable hook set remains eleven events; SubagentStop work in nightly releases is not treated as a stable contract. Corrected JSON output for text-only advisory hooks and native prompt_response session summaries. Installed binary observations remain separate.
tools.status_note: Gemini CLI drops free + paid (AI Pro/Ultra) tiers on 2026-06-18 in favor of the new Antigravity CLI (we ship generate_antigravity.py); enterprise Gemini Code Assist Standard/Enterprise keeps full Gemini CLI support. Profile full now emits project and user-tier native agents. Gemini extension export remains class C / not adopted; extension manifests live at the package root and installed extensions live under ~/.gemini/extensions/<name>/.

documentation_review.note: Native agent kind: local and inherited model/tools remain compatible. Text-only advisory handlers now emit native JSON: SessionStart context uses hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext; quality-check, MCP health, commit-quality and SessionEnd use systemMessage. Pipefail preserves infrastructure errors and blocking handlers retain their exit status. Session persistence accepts AfterAgent.prompt_response without overriding last_assistant_message. Optional model discovery CLI and preview-only event changes require no generated model override.

tools.release_review_note: 2026-11-06 classes A/C/D: current GitHub stable release remains Cline 4.1.26 (2026-10-26). Reviewed emitted skill/rule paths and hook payloads; provider catalog and cloud-task UI changes do not require generator changes.

documentation_review.note: Emitted .cline/skills remains the recommended skill location. Primary repository hook documentation confirms extensionless .clinerules/hooks files and cancel/contextModification output; TaskComplete and PreCompact are still marked coming soon for the extension. Run-start hooks can be fire-and-forget in CLI/SDK hosts. .clineignore remains a documented deprecation outside toolkit output. No model or approval defaults changed.
access_notes: The customization/hooks docs page returned navigation only; the official repository's hook README supplied the actual contract.

tools.release_review_note: 2026-11-06 classes A/C: reviewed Zoo Code stable 3.94.0, published 2026-10-31. Provider/catalog, MCP OAuth, UI and dependency updates do not change the emitted .roomodes or rule-file contracts. https://github.com/Zoo-Code-Org/Zoo-Code/releases/tag/v3.94.0
tools.status_note: Upstream RooCodeInc/Roo-Code archived/read-only 2026-05-15, frozen at v3.54.0. Review the successor Zoo-Code-Org/Zoo-Code (marketplace ZooCodeOrganization.zoo-code, docs.zoocode.dev); release 3.92.0 was reviewed on 2026-10-27. Current custom-mode docs explicitly retain JSON .roomodes, and the documented Roo-to-Zoo import accepts exported settings. Emitted .roomodes and .roo/rules contracts remain compatible; this does not establish parity for every product feature. Use Zoo GitHub releases as the authoritative release feed. Global skills use native ~/.agents/skills discovery.

documentation_review.note: Current Zoo documentation still accepts project .roomodes as JSON or YAML with the emitted description, whenToUse and read/edit/command/mcp groups. Global YAML preference does not deprecate project JSON. Roo-to-Zoo settings import remains available. Preserve current modes and model selection; optional provider, OAuth and UI additions require no generator changes.

The options reference retains emitted architect/auto-accept-architect, read, lint-cmd, test-cmd, model/editor-model, commit-prompt, attribution and language settings. No generator migration is needed. Removed a stale latest-version claim from the test header so release metadata remains centralized. Stable package availability and the documentation's unreleased main-branch features are recorded separately.

GitHub's latest-release endpoint still points to 0.86.0 and the HISTORY page labels 0.86.1, so use package metadata plus the stable source tag rather than treating that endpoint as authoritative. No model defaults changed. https://pypi.org/project/aider-chat/0.86.2/

documentation_review.note: Pinned evidence to official /cli/v0/ references. Stable 0.x still uses view, launch-process, str-replace-editor, save-file and codebase-retrieval; disabled_tools overrides tools, so emitted agents correctly omit it. Upcoming 1.x renames native tools and changes allowlist semantics, adds PromptSubmit/Notification and removes plugin rules. That prerelease migration is recorded but not applied to stable users. No permission or model expansion.

tools.release_review_note: 2026-11-06 classes A/C/D: reviewed Antigravity App 2.29.0 (2026-11-03) and CLI 1.5.1 (2026-11-05). Optional PreInvocation termination/error output, remote agents, ACP and plugin-auth additions do not require enabling new policies. Workflow retirement remains covered by migration issue #34.
tools.status_note: Reviewed App 2.29.0 and CLI 1.5.1. The shared ~/.gemini/config/skills surface is now canonical for App and CLI; legacy CLI skill locations remain supported. Optional PreInvocation terminationBehavior/errorMessage and remote-agent/ACP features are not enabled by toolkit defaults.

documentation_review.note: Existing native hook input/output, agent inheritance and plugin exports remain compatible. PreInvocation can now terminate and inject an errorMessage, but the toolkit's advisory ephemeralMessage remains valid. ~/.gemini/config/skills is the shared App/CLI canonical global surface; CLI still supports ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills and ~/.gemini/skills. Keep existing backward-compatible pointers. The six documented hook events and same-named workflow replacement skills remain valid; optional new UI, ACP, remote-agent and authentication features are not enabled by this sync.

tools.release_review_note: 2026-11-06 classes A/B/C: verified stable Codex 0.167.0, published 2026-11-06. Current native hook documentation adds PreModelRequest/PostModelRequest diagnostics. Existing skill, agent and plugin contracts remain compatible. Local installed versions are recorded separately. https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.167.0

documentation_review.note: Accept and preserve user model-request command/MCP hooks during project/global refreshes; no default diagnostic hooks are emitted. The events cannot block requests or modify model context. Existing native agent inheritance, skill discovery, plugin packaging and hook trust remain compatible. Command and local/plugin hooks are unavailable with cloud orchestration; preserve user models, efforts and permissions.

tools.release_review_note: 2026-11-06 classes B/D: current @opencode/cli latest is 2.2.5 (2026-10-30); legacy opencode-ai latest and GitHub releases/latest still report 1.19.5. Live V2 migration docs now use the opencode binary and no longer label V2 beta. Migrated emitted plugin to the documented dual V2 setup / V1 server entrypoint, requiring V1 >=1.18.29 for compatibility.
tools.status_note: OpenCode V2 2.2.5 is the current @opencode/cli release; the separately maintained opencode-ai V1 package remains at 1.19.5. V2 uses the opencode binary and introduces a new plugin/server API. The toolkit emits a documented dual-version plugin object (id/setup/server), supporting V2 and V1 >=1.18.29 without changing the auto-discovered .opencode/plugins/ai-toolkit-hooks.js path. Older V1 clients must upgrade before using this plugin. User plugin declarations, agents, commands, skills, models and permissions are preserved. Optional GUI plugin and model-generation features remain unconfigured. Global/project plugin IDs are scoped; one runtime executor per location avoids duplicate hooks.

documentation_review.note: V2 rejects V1 async factory exports. The toolkit now emits one default object with id/setup/server; V2 registers native tool and session hooks plus an abortable, location-filtered event subscription, while V1 >=1.18.29 uses server(). V2 source confirms standalone auto-discovered JS plugin files remain supported, so the managed path stays unchanged. Native shell inputs and event.data.sessionID are translated explicitly. Existing agent, command and skill files remain compatible; optional GUI/image/decision APIs and compaction percentage settings are not enabled. Native 2.2.5 smoke verifies both scoped global/project plugin IDs active; shared location/workspace ownership avoids ordinary duplicate advisory execution and supports unload takeover. Safety guards run in every layer; advisory deduplication is best effort during reload and stream failures release ownership. Both entrypoints use real subprocesses; guard infrastructure failures block execution. Managed generation is transactional and refuses user-owned collisions.
